observed_outcome: Run 34275113635 (workflow_dispatch, head ddfd56f, master): the build step failed, exit code 1 at the baked RUN python -m pytest tests/ -q. My prediction was wrong about the mechanism -- I expected a missing system library (the insightface/libxcb shape DOCKER.md documents). The real cause: dozens of tests fail with FileNotFoundError-shaped errors -- test_business_map, test_env_check, test_release_check, test_state_map, test_node_dossier, test_spine_check, test_runs, test_claims, test_obs_export, test_pipeline_cli, test_mutation, test_next_action, test_invariants, test_extras_check, plus test_intel errors. All of these read outside engine/ (lib/, oss/, corpus/, state/, .github/workflows/, CLAUDE.md, execution_state.json -- CLAUDE.md's own engine.yml comment already names this: 'The engine's tests read outside engine/'). deploy/local/compose.yaml's build context is engine/ only (context: ../../engine), so none of that tree exists inside the image; Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] inside the container resolves to filesystem root, not the repository root. C-014 is CONTRADICTED, not SUPPORTED -- measured, not assumed. This is an architecture mismatch between what deploy/local/Dockerfile assumed (only needs to be able to run the engine and its tests) and what the engine test suite actually is (partly a monorepo-wide gate suite that happens to live in engine/tests/). Not a one-line fix: real options are widening the build context to the repo root (changing the image size story DOCKER.md documents) or scoping the baked test command to a principled subset. Recorded as a finding rather than patched blind.
